ayahOccurrences.text: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَلْفِظُ is in the derivative form: يَلْفِظ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ف/ظ   l–f–ẓ to spit out, to emit, to cast out; to enunciate, to utter, to speak, utterance; to expire. Of this root, only يَلْفِظ yalfiẓ occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَلْفِظ yalfiẓ [imperf. of v. trans.] to utter, to enunciate

(50:18) مَا‏ ‏يَلْفِظُ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏قَوْلٍ‏ ‏إِلاَّ لَدَيْهِ‏ ‏رَقِيبٌ‏ ‏عَتِيدٌ ‏‏not an utterance does he utter without, [there being] beside him, an observer at the ready.
